name: Tropica Island Resort
positioning: Adults-only island resort in a private bay on Malolo Island in Fiji's Mamanuca Islands, where every bure and suite type pairs contemporary comfort with traditional Fijian design
best_for: Couples who want a beachfront bure with its own plunge pool
Adults who want reefs, dive sites, kayaking and snorkelling close by

facts.text: Tropica sits in a private sheltered bay on Malolo Island, with views over the nearby islands of Fiji's Mamanucas.
Tropica is an island resort exclusively for adults.
The resort blends contemporary comfort with traditional Fijian design.
Every room has a private outdoor shower.
The Beachfront Pool Bures are west-facing, each with a private beachside deck.
Sanctuary Pool Suites have an open-plan bedroom and living area and a private plunge pool.
The resort has a main infinity pool.
The resort has its own spa, the Tropica Day Spa.
Guests can explore nearby surf breaks, reefs and dive sites, and go fishing, kayaking, paddle boarding and snorkelling.
The resort is on Malolo Island, 25 km west of Nadi International Airport.
A helicopter can fly guests from Nadi Airport to the resort in about 10 minutes.
Full breakfast is included in the nightly rate.

highlights.text: Beachfront Pool Bures each have their own plunge pool and are set a few metres from the water's edge.
In the Deluxe Pool Bure, bifold doors open to a large infinity-edge pool overlooking tropical gardens.
Guests can take part in a traditional kava ceremony, coconut husking and sulu (sarong) tying.
Dining experiences include gourmet beach picnics on secluded shores and intimate jetty dinners with seafood platters and paired wines.
Staff greet guests with 'Bula!' and share Fijian culture, including through song.

considerations.text: Most water transfers leave from Port Denarau Marina, about a 25-minute drive from Nadi Airport.
The Sanctuary Suites and the Deluxe Pool Bure sit on higher ground and are reached by stairs.
An optional Full Board Meal Plan is available, but drinks are not included in it.
